checks: Starts a stdio MCP server, completes the handshake and lists its tools; new tools default to Ask first
Calls tools and returns their text; tool errors surface as errors, not answers
Only requests that match a connected tool are offered to it; ordinary chat and built-in questions are not
Model-written arguments are checked against the tool schema; schemas are reduced to a bounded, grammar-safe subset
A tool call becomes an approval card; nothing runs before approval, it runs exactly once after, and the receipt keeps the output
Off hides a tool from Lin and refuses it even if asked directly; stale Tools edits are refused
Server settings are validated: names, command, argument and environment limits, working folder
A tool description that tries to instruct Lin is flagged and never shown to the model; huge results are cut to a bounded size
A server that crashes mid-call or cannot start reports a clear error within seconds instead of hanging Lin
Tools settings survive restarting Lin; removing a server forgets it
